name: llamafile
desc: Mozilla's single-file executable: one binary bundles a model + llama.cpp + a web UI. Runs anywhere with zero install.

name: LocalAI
desc: OpenAI-compatible local API that fronts many backends (llama.cpp, whisper, diffusers). Drop-in replacement for OpenAI endpoints.

name: OnnxStream
desc: Runs Stable Diffusion XL on a Raspberry Pi Zero 2 by streaming weights — the extreme edge of local inference.

name: RWKV
desc: Linear-attention (RNN-style) models — constant memory regardless of context length, friendly to CPU and low VRAM.

name: Falcon
desc: TII's open models, Apache-2.0, once a top open leaderboard performer; still solid for fine-tuning experiments.

name: Faraday
desc: Desktop local-AI app with a focus on offline-first chat and roleplay; batteries included, no terminal needed.

name: kotaemon
desc: Open-source RAG UI — chat with your documents over a local model with a clean Gradio interface.

name: Backyard AI
desc: Character/RP-focused local AI app with a desktop client and mobile companion.

name: llm-compressor
desc: Neural Magic's library for pruning + quantization; pairs with vLLM to shrink and accelerate serving models.

name: GGUF quant guide
desc: The canonical explanation of K-quants and how to pick Q4_K_M vs Q8_0 for your hardware.

name: LLMPerf
desc: Ray's toolkit for benchmarking LLM API and serving throughput/latency — useful for self-hosted stacks too.

name: Artificial Analysis
desc: Independent model-vs-model speed/price/quality charts; mostly API but a useful reference for local baselines.

name: LocalLLaMA build guides
desc: Community wiki covering the GPU tiers, RAM bandwidth math, and common build mistakes.

name: Craft Computing GPU tier list
desc: Practical, current guidance on which GPUs are worth buying for local AI as of this generation.
